project_type: Next.js 14 App Router + Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL (Neon) + Cashfree payments + Shiprocket shipping
build_system: npm + Next.js 14 compiler. No test framework. Build: `npm run build`. Lint: `npm run lint`. No test runner — verification is build + lint only.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run build` from e:\work\raghul-snacks\raghul-snacks — must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors. 2. Run `npm run lint` — must pass. These are the only automated checks; no unit tests exist.
environment_constraints: Workspace root is e:\work\raghul-snacks\raghul-snacks. All file paths must be absolute or relative to this root. The dev server should NOT be restarted during implementation — verification uses build only.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Match existing code style: TypeScript strict mode, no semicolons in some files but present in others — match the file being edited. CSS class names follow BEM-like conventions in globals.css; CSS modules use camelCase. Server components have no 'use client' directive.
key_patterns: Server components: no directive, use async functions, import from 'next/headers' and 'next/navigation'. Client components: 'use client' at top. Admin auth: `cookies()` from 'next/headers', `isValidAdminSession(cookieStore.get(adminCookieName())?.value)`, `redirect('/admin/login')` — see app/admin/page.tsx as the canonical example. Product stock field: `product.stock` is `integer | null` in the DB schema — check `typeof product.stock === 'number' && product.stock <= 0` to avoid null false-positives. formatWeight in lib/catalog.ts appends 'g' to bare numbers — never use it for item quantity counts. Cart item IDs: plain products use String(product.id), variants use `${product.id}-v${variantId}`. Buy-now: read via readBuyNowItem() in sessionStorage, cleared via clearBuyNowItem(). orderPlacedRef in checkout-wizard.tsx tracks payment completion (set to true after successful payment).
directory_structure: app/(store)/ — storefront routes (page, product/[slug], combo/[slug], checkout, orders, policies/*). app/admin/ — admin panel routes. app/api/ — API routes (cashfree/, orders/, auth/google/, coupons/, checkout/, locations/). components/ — React components (product/, cart/, admin-*). lib/ — server utilities (catalog.ts, cashfree.ts, order-pricing.ts, admin-auth.ts, customer-auth.ts, buy-now.ts, db.ts). drizzle/ — DB schema and migrations.
